born.why: The code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous species, using a "taste first" strategy for new fruits when hunger is high to gather data without full risk, and only carrying targeted fruits to optimize energy expenditure.

The code uses diary history to distinguish poisonous fruits (which are avoided) from safe ones, prioritizing eating when starving and carrying when safe and not burdened, ensuring long-term survival through cautious exploration and efficient resource gathering.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starving, avoids fruits with more poison records than safe ones, tastes unknown fruits to build knowledge base, and leverages historical data on specific fruit keys to make informed decisions.
